name: Peyton "p80n-sec" Kennedy
biography: Peyton 'p80n-sec' Kennedy is a Senior Security Researcher at Endor Labs, where he focuses on offensive security research, vulnerability discovery, and exploit development against the open source projects shaping modern software. His research has produced CVE disclosures across widely deployed frameworks and platforms, including koa.js and openclaw, with a consistent focus on the gap between what platforms claim about their threat models and what they actually enforce.
